card.title: IPhone XS No Service, Always Searching For Cell Signal

source.title: IPhone XS No Service, Always Searching For Cell Signal

claims.statement: iPhone XS / XS Max baseband faults: sandwich separation (iSocket test, reball), bottom board swap (move BB CPU, BB EEPROM and Wi-Fi) or BB CPU reball (lower success). Update, don't restore.

procedure: Split; repair ripped pads; iSocket test.
Bottom board swap or BB CPU reball.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
